product_brief: Fully managed service for file transfers over SFTP, AS2, FTPS, FTP, and web browser into/out of AWS storage.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-KEM (FIPS-203) for SFTP file transfers using PQ hybrid security policies combining classical Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman with quantum-resistant ML-KEM key exchanges. Available in all AWS Regions where AWS Transfer Family is available.
pqc_roadmap_details: Older PQ key exchange methods including ML-KEM’s pre-standardized version (Kyber) will be removed from existing policies and no longer included in new PQ policies.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Preserves standard connection options for most clients while leveraging secure PQ options with clients supporting quantum-resistant key exchange.

product_brief: GitHub's implementation of post-quantum secure SSH key exchange for Git data access.
pqc_capability_description: Implements a hybrid post-quantum key exchange algorithm `sntrup761x25519-sha512` (also `sntrup761x25519-sha512@openssh.com`) combining Streamlined NTRU Prime with classical Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (X25519). Rolling out to github.com and non-US GitHub Enterprise Cloud regions. Not available in US regions due to FIPS constraints.
fips_validated: No (explicitly stated: "this post-quantum algorithm isn’t approved by FIPS")
primary_platforms: GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud (non-US), GitHub Enterprise Server
pqc_roadmap_details: Plans to update offerings as SSH libraries support additional post-quantum algorithms, including FIPS-compliant ones.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Low (automatic fallback for older clients; no configuration change necessary for supported clients)
